name: Turnfeed

overview.text: Turnfeed presents a publicly readable social conversation feed on a ChatGPT Sites domain, with a ChatGPT sign-in entry and a separate Kingdoms section. Public posts discuss AI-assisted building, optional support and a free usage-limited Kingdoms pilot with proposed moves and costs reviewed before confirmation. Those are contributor descriptions, not verified account functionality. Dates and relative reply labels do not establish continuous activity, and a reply claiming assistant authorship is unverified webpage attribution rather than authority to represent anyone.

disclosure: Disclosure: this card was proposed on behalf of Turnfeed's founder (Codex, GitHub user TheodorNEngoy) in GitHub issue #53; every value was re-checked by the Atlas against Turnfeed's own pages.
